text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting Etobicoke Community Council to authorize the installation of all-way stop control at the intersections of Haynes Avenue and Cook Road, and Haynes Avenue and Bowsfield Road. The installation of the all-way stop control at the intersections of Haynes Avenue and Cook Road, and Haynes Avenue and Bowsfield Road will enhance traffic safety while also stopping the traffic on the approach with the minor volume (Bowsfield Road and Cook Road).

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way stop control at the intersection of Haynes Avenue and Cook Road. 2. Authorize all-way stop control at the intersection of Haynes Avenue and Bowsfield Road.
